definitions.explanation: A friend or close acquaintance. More literary or formal than {友達|ともだち}. Often used in compound words or literary contexts.

examples.japanese: {友|とも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にし⟦なさい→なさる：01307_nasaru⟧。
examples.notes: Famous quote from the Analects of Confucius

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{苦楽|くらく}→苦楽：05566_kuraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{共|とも}に→共に：03468_tomoni⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧{友|とも}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: He is a friend who has shared both hardships and joys with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出会|であ}えた→出会う：02298_deau⟧。
examples.english: I met a friend for life.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{久|ひさ}しぶりに→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: I met up with a friend from my school days after a long time.

notes:
USAGE:
{友|とも} is more literary and formal than ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧. It appears in compounds, proverbs, set phrases and writing, rarely on its own in conversation.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{友情|ゆうじょう}→友情：03648_yuujou⟧: friendship
- ⟦{親友|しんゆう}→親友：03266_shinyuu⟧: close friend
- ⟦{旧友|きゅうゆう}→旧友：17475_kyuuyuu⟧: old friend
- ⟦{学友|がくゆう}→学友：27117_gakuyuu⟧: school friend
- ⟦{戦友|せんゆう}→戦友：20019_senyuu⟧: comrade in arms
- ⟦{友好|ゆうこう}→友好：03644_yuukou⟧: friendship, amity (between nations)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{友|とも}: a lifelong friend
- ⟦{良|よ}き→良い：02350_yoi⟧{友|とも}: a good friend (literary)
- {本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{友|とも}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have books as one's companions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧: the everyday word for friend
- ⟦{友人|ゆうじん}→友人：03649_yuujin⟧: friend (polite; formal speech and writing)
